evidence.excerpt: We are live on Product Hunt with @superlogYC, and we need your vote! This launch was never meant to stop at a single milestone. After topping #Bookface and reaching the front page of #HackerNews, we decided to go all in and launch Superlog on Product Hunt, hunted by @garrytan, president of @ycombinator. We only have 12 hours, and every single upvote makes a difference. So once again, we need your support. Link in the first comment: 👉 Upvote/Comment Superlog (YC P26) on Product Hunt 🔁 Share…
